cli_help.output:
usage: study_inputs.py [-h] --source SOURCE {plan,record,progress} ...

Prepare and record the fixed study input sequence in external, immutable JSON
files.

positional arguments:
  {plan,record,progress}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --source SOURCE

usage: study_inputs.py plan [-h] --source-sha256 SOURCE_SHA256
                            [--exposed-repository EXPOSED_REPOSITORY] --output
                            OUTPUT

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --source-sha256 SOURCE_SHA256
  --exposed-repository EXPOSED_REPOSITORY
  --output OUTPUT

usage: study_inputs.py record [-h] --output OUTPUT previous attempt

positional arguments:
  previous
  attempt

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT

usage: study_inputs.py progress [-h] record

positional arguments:
  record

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
